Results.ReviewText: Generally pleased with the grill except for one, possibilly two things.  The first is the fact that it the ignitor module it came with is ether designed for another unit or has a basic design error. It is mounted with two screws to the flat sheet metal side of the grill stand.  The  problem is, there is a quarter inch difference between the mounting services of the two points on the igniter. Another words it doesn’t sit flat on the sheet metal.  I called customer service right away they promptly  sent out a replacement part… that was identical.   When I contacted Test and her service again, they maintained this was the proper part. This is clearly not the case. The grill functions and I got some longer screws and spacers to make it sit properly, but when I buy a premium brand like Weber,  I expected more.  The other issue is I’m not sure if the propane tank scale is correct. When we install the first time, it only registered have full on the scale.   It’s now showing empty. If we only get one or two more sessions out of it than the scale is correct, but if it lasts a while longer I would say it’s not

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
